obernants.domain: 10,200 small repeated-multiplication cases (25 bases x17 exponents x24 positive moduli), zero/one modulus and exponent-zero boundaries, full-width parity/products, and 1,024 fixed-seed reduction/addition cases.
obernants.operator: U is candidate implementations paired with pass/fail on the finite fixture set F. R(P,pass) iff all assertions succeed; R(P,fail) iff a terminating call/assertion panics or a mismatch occurs. U minus R comprises false passes despite failure and false failures despite all assertions holding. Harness crashes/nontermination are excluded.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional relation with bounded evidence; no universal proof.
obernants.assumptions: Standard Rust arithmetic and oracle, ordinary terminating execution.
